metadata.description: Short prefix for resource names (lowercase).
Location for all resources.
Foundry AI Services account name.
Foundry project name (displayed inside AI Foundry portal).
Storage account name (must be globally unique, 3-24 lowercase).
Blob container name for HR policy PDFs.

Optional principalId of the GitHub Actions OIDC UAMI. When set, gets Storage Blob Data Contributor on the storage account so the agent-deploy workflow can upload artifacts via AAD (--auth-mode login).
Name of the Azure Table that stores per-call cost records (read by the costboard dashboard).

Extra principalIds to grant Storage Table Data Contributor on the cost table (e.g. the costboard dashboard identity, the VMSS user-assigned identity, or a local developer objectId). The deployer principal (when set) is granted automatically.
Azure AI Search service name.
Azure AI Search SKU.
Capacity (K TPM) for gpt-4.1-mini (primary chat model).
Capacity (K TPM) for o4-mini.
Capacity (K TPM) for text-embedding-3-large.
ACS resource name.
ACS data residency location.
ACR name. 5-50 lowercase alphanumeric, globally unique.
Deploy ACR alongside the rest of the stack. Set false if it already exists outside this template.
Deploy the avatar VMSS stack. Set false to skip while iterating on the Foundry side only.
Local admin password for the avatar VMSS (break-glass via Bastion).
Bootstrap zip URL for the avatar VMSS (uploaded by the agent-deploy workflow).
URL to install.ps1 (separate blob, uploaded by the agent-deploy workflow). Required when avatarBootstrapZipUrl is set.
Install the bot TLS cert from KV onto VMSS instances. Set false on first deploy (before the cert exists), then re-deploy with true.
Email for avatar stack alerts (empty = no alerts).
Avatar VMSS instance count.
Region.
Common name prefix (lowercase, <=13 chars). E.g. "<NAME_PREFIX>".
Resource tags applied to every resource.
Existing Foundry (Cognitive Services) account name. From main.bicep output.
Existing Foundry project name used by Voice Live agent mode.
Hosted Foundry agent name used by the avatar sidecar. Must match the agent name created by hosted-agent/deploy.sh (default there: lisa).
Hosted Foundry agent version. Empty means latest/routed version.
Tenant ID used by sidecar token pinning.
Voice Live API version for the sidecar.
Azure voice name used by the sidecar when no agent metadata voice config is attached.
Avatar character used by the sidecar.
Avatar style used by the sidecar.
Optional public HTTPS URL the Voice Live service can fetch to use as the avatar background image. Empty = use avatarBackgroundColor instead.
Optional CSS hex color (e.g. "#00ff00" or "#FFFFFFFF") used as the avatar background when no image URL is set. Empty = Voice Live default (transparent).
Language hint for sidecar transcription/VAD config.
Existing ACR name. Empty = skip ACR-related RBAC.
Storage account name used for VMSS bootstrap artifacts (zip + install.ps1).
Bootstrap blob URL (signed or readable by VMSS MI). Required to install the bot+sidecar.
URL to install.ps1 (separate blob). Required when bootstrapZipUrl is set.
Bump this string to force CSE bootstrap to re-run on existing instances when install.ps1 / lisa-latest.zip changed but blob URLs are stable.
Install the AzureKeyVault VM extension to sync bot-tls-cert into LocalMachine\My. Set false on first deploy (before the cert exists) and re-deploy with true after.
VMSS instance count. 1 = no concurrency. 2 = hot-standby HA.
VM SKU.
Local admin user (break-glass via Bastion).
Local admin password.
DNS label prefix for VMSS instance public IPs (used only when useLoadBalancer = false; legacy mode).

Use Standard Load Balancer in front of the VMSS (recommended). Required for the Microsoft Graph calling bot media SDK self-test to pass (per-instance Public IPs do NOT support NAT hairpin and the SDK can't be fooled with /etc/hosts because it discovers its public IP via IMDS).
DNS label prefix for the LB public IP. Empty = no DNS label.
Email address for monitor alerts. Empty = no alerts.
Key Vault public network access. Production should use Disabled with a private endpoint.
Key Vault network ACL default action. Production should use Deny.
Provision Application Gateway in front of the signaling port. Requires kvCertSecretId.
Versionless KV secret URI for the AppGw TLS PFX. Required when enableAppGateway = true.
User-assigned MI ID with KV Secrets User on the AppGw cert vault. Required when enableAppGateway = true.
DNS label for the AppGw frontend public IP.
Provision a Key Vault private endpoint in the privateLink subnet and link privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net to the Avatar VNet.
Private DNS zone name for Key Vault private endpoints.

Azure Bastion subnet prefix (must be at least /26).

Provision a Standard Load Balancer + public IP that fronts the VMSS for both Graph signaling (443) and the Skype Bots Media platform (8445 per-instance NAT).
DNS label for the public load balancer frontend. Becomes <prefix>.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com. Empty = no DNS label (use raw IP).

First port in the inbound NAT pool that maps to backend 8445 on each VMSS instance. Frontend port for instance i is mediaNatStartPort + i. Default 8445 — keeps the FIRST instance reachable on the symmetric port 8445 (matches Microsoft Graph calling sample defaults).
Last port in the inbound NAT pool. Pool size caps the maximum supported VMSS instance count.

Use Standard Load Balancer for inbound traffic (recommended). When false, each instance gets its own per-instance public IP — useful for diagnostics only.
Standard LB backend pool ID. Required when useLoadBalancer = true.
Standard LB inbound NAT pool ID for media (8445 per-instance). Required when useLoadBalancer = true.

Bootstrap blob URL (zip with bot binaries + sidecar). MI must be authorised on this account.
URL to install.ps1 (separate blob from the bot zip). MI must be authorised. Required when bootstrapZipUrl is set.
Custom Script Extension command line. Receives bootstrapZipUrl as %1. Filename must match the last URL segment of installScriptUrl (CSE saves downloads using the URL leaf name).
Key Vault name where bot-aad-secret etc. live (mounted via AKV VM extension).

App Insights connection string (passed through to the apps as env var).
Public service FQDN that Microsoft Graph will hit for signaling and that the bot media SDK uses for its self-test. Typically the LB FQDN. Empty string disables the override.
First port in the LB media NAT pool. Bot reads its instance index and uses (mediaNatStartPort + index) as InstancePublicPort.
